correctness.rationale: Source-supported facet inequalities are exact. For any h≥2 and a,b≤d≤h/2, derivative of R_h with respect to either coordinate has negative numerator bounded by (a+b)(h−3h²/4)<0, so nonterminal chords cannot touch the candidate disk. The top and ±terminal chords give the optimal radius and unique center by summing supporting-distance inequalities. Deletion polygons inherit the same strict inequalities. Rationalization yields a uniform error below 1/(2h), with complete fixed-prime/infinite-prime rigidity. Standalone 65-digit checker passed 1,999 h values and 15,517 facet comparisons, independently supplemented by 149 direct LP optimizations and 591 deletion tests; no finite check substitutes for the universal proof.
